definitions.explanation: The physical phenomenon produced by magnets or electric currents.

examples.japanese: {磁気|じき}⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{入室|にゅうしつ}→入室：noentry⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I enter the room using a magnetic card.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{磁気|じき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{磁気|じき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦やすい→〜やすい：18367_yasui⟧。
examples.english: This machine is easily affected by strong magnetism.

notes:
{磁気|じき} refers to magnetism and magnetic force. Composed of {磁|じ} (magnet) + {気|き} (energy/force).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {磁気|じき}⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧: magnetic card (e.g., credit cards, hotel keys)
- {磁気|じき}⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧: magnetic tape
- {磁気|じき}⟦{嵐|あらし}→嵐：01695_arashi⟧: magnetic storm
- ⟦{地磁気|ちじき}→地磁気：noentry⟧: geomagnetism
- {磁気|じき}⟦センサー→センサー：29781_sensaa⟧: magnetic sensor

USAGE:
Commonly encountered in everyday life with {磁気|じき}⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧. Caution: strong magnets can damage {磁気|じき}⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧ by erasing the magnetic data.

HOMOPHONES:
- ⟦{磁器|じき}→磁器：03335_jiki⟧: porcelain, ceramic ware
- ⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧: time, season, period

These three words all read じき but are written with different kanji.
